purpose: Stage 0, near bucket: measure kernel K_v1 tool reliability where the fixed stance has preflight evidence. Engineering column only, no agent, no test split. Out-of-reach situations are the far bucket, owned by a future move tool (idealized first, locomotion later).
instance_note: Generated before execution by the frozen tabletop sampler with the T03 near-side grid injected (same adapter as the T03 line, harness/t03_curriculum.generate). Seeds seed_start..seed_start+7 per template, asset index 0..7. No outcome filter; generation or qualification rejections stay as not-ready rows and are not resampled. Containers stay at the sampler fixed position (0, 0.29).

baselines.negative: 2 s wait on the first instance of each template; any goal satisfaction invalidates the whole batch
baselines.engineering: fixed K_v1 tool chain (TP01: locate,grasp; TP03/TP04: locate,grasp,place)

related_runs.outputs/tabletop_kernel_20261113_002: Same K_v1 on 24 frozen dataset instances, all in the far bucket. Kept unchanged; its far-bucket results are the gap record below, not grasp reliability.

far_bucket_gap.evidence: outputs/tabletop_kernel_20261113_002: grasp preflight rejected 15/15 (targets at pelvis x 0.65-0.97 m, 5 on the right of the left hand); TP01_train_001 and _003 targets outside the head camera view at locate.
far_bucket_gap.class: kernel gap: no stance change tool
far_bucket_gap.owner: move tool: an idealized base placement as K_v2 after the near bucket is measured, then real locomotion with T05
far_bucket_gap.not_counted_as: grasp or locate reliability inside the near bucket

prediction: Generation: at least 20/24 instances are ready. TP03 cups can only clear the long tray (half x 0.27 m) in the x=0.40 grid column.
Locate in the near bucket: TP01 >=5/8, TP03 >=4/8, TP04 >=4/8. Remaining failures are colour-rule misses (apples, blue slim tumblers) or white-cup/grey-can ambiguity, not out-of-view targets.
Grasp preflight passes in at least 60% of episodes that reach grasp, pooled over templates; T03 near-grid evidence was most instances passing, with failures in the y=0.25 row at x>=0.35.
TP03 is the weakest: its cups sit in the x=0.40 column, half of whose train cells are the y=0.25 edge.
TP01 full success 1-4/8 (point 2/8); TP03 0-2/8 (point 0/8): tray never executed, cups at the reach edge, placement offset tuned on the platter; TP04 1-4/8 (point 2/8): T03 near-side parent was 1/4.
At least 70% of tool failures are detected by the tool itself.
falsification: Grasp preflight passes in fewer than half of the episodes that reach grasp, pooled: the near grid is not a valid stance bucket for this kernel and the bucket definition must be revised before any training round.
Any template reaches 6/8 or more: the kernel is stronger than predicted.
More than half of tool failures are undetected: the kernel cannot support check-and-retry routines without new monitors.
Negative control satisfies a goal: the whole batch is invalid.
decision_rule: A tool is opened for a template's situation buckets when its boundary ok rate is at least 60% there; otherwise the bucket is narrowed or the user decides on an idealized tool. Thresholds are initial values, not validated settings. Rates are computed per template inside the near bucket only.
